comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features over OC_comments with the same null and empty rules, but the per-comment predicates differ. Feature 0 is 1 if any comment employs abstract reasoning, and it explicitly allows an anecdote in the same comment because abstract reasoning is judged independently. Feature 1 requires the comment to rebut mainly through abstract logic and to contain no named specific real-world example or analogy. That is an extra exclusion, and it is stricter than feature 0, which would count a comment with an example or analogy. Feature 1 also says 'mainly', while feature 0 has no such qualifier. Feature 0 excludes reliance on personal experience, while feature 1 excludes named real-world examples and analogies. The eligibility sets differ materially.
